basic_profile.bio: A fresh face on Reddit, JazzedPelicanNewbie is a 27-year-old basketball enthusiast living in New Orleans. By day, they work as a lab technician at a local hospital, and by night, they dive into the world of online music and basketball discussions. As a recent college graduate with a degree in biology, they are passionate about genetics and often dream about pursuing a career in genetic counseling. Outside of work, they enjoy exploring the local music scene and have a soft spot for indie artists on BandCamp. They are single and spend most of their online hours in the late evenings, especially after work. They are still finding their footing in the Reddit community, often lurking more than posting.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in biology, JazzedPelicanNewbie has a solid understanding of genetics, which they continue to explore through self-study and online courses. Their interest in basketball stems from years of playing and watching the sport, providing them with a decent grasp of the game's nuances, particularly in defensive strategies.
